operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 cost of materials and goods was 57.9% of revenue against 59.9% in Q4FY25, holding EBITDA margin at 18.07%.
FY26 fiscal incentive income of ₹45.72 Cr for April 2024 to September 2025 was recognised in Q3FY26 after a State Government approval.
New Labour Codes led to a past service cost of ₹48.56 Cr (consolidated) recognised in Q3FY26 and FY26 towards gratuity and compensated absences.
Q4FY26 growth was ~9% in the first two months before moderating in March on supply disruptions in the International Business following the West Asia conflict.
E-commerce contributed ~6% to the Domestic business in FY26, driven by e-commerce-first launches and a premium mix.
Q4FY26 volume growth was close to 5.5%; domestic business grew close to 9-9.5% while the international business was negative for the quarter on West Asia disruption.
E-commerce was 6% of domestic sales in FY26 (4% in FY25), with quick commerce about 70% of e-commerce and adjacency categories growing 2.7x there.
Palm oil is covered for 5 months and wheat for 5.5-6 months at favourable prices; fuel and laminate costs are inflationary.
Consolidated related-party flows to parent Associated Biscuits International Limited (ABIL), UK were ₹808.57 Cr of expense in FY26, 4.2% of revenue.
Britannia Bel Foods Private Limited (JV) had FY26 purchases of goods of ₹269.15 Cr and sales of ₹144.38 Cr with the group, and posted a loss of ₹30.57 Cr.
Royalty and shared service expense to Nowrosjee Wadia and Sons Limited was ₹64.56 Cr in FY26 (FY25: ₹60.53 Cr).
General trade grew 1.5x of FY26 growth in Q1FY27
Other channels grew 2.5x of general trade in Q1FY27
Key states delivered 1.8x of FY26 growth in Q1FY27
At the 107th AGM, 27.5902% of public institution votes were cast against re-appointing Ness N. Wadia as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director.
Mr. Rejin Surendran was Global Chief Information Officer at Wipro Enterprises Private Limited, leading a technology team across 25 countries for over 4.5 years.
LIC held 1,20,59,614 shares, or 5.006% of Britannia's voting capital, after buying 53,260 shares in the market on 16 September 2026.
